body.name: Support-cleaned coherent cross-fitted nuisance system
body.construction:
For each training fold, obtain one raw label-aligned product-factor fit \((\widehat m,\widehat\pi,\widehat M_A,\widehat M_Z,\widehat f)\) on the declared outcome support \(\mathcal Y\).  Choose \(\tau_{S,n}\) from the fold size and training data alone and apply the support-cleaning map to obtain \((\bar M_A,\bar M_Z)\).  The coherent fitted nuisance tuple uses \((\bar M_A,\bar M_Z)\), not the raw measurement matrices.  Retain only fitted laws satisfying the computable cleaned-law half-margin restrictions
\[
 \min_j\widehat\pi_j\geq\varepsilon/2,\qquad
 \min_{a,z}\widehat d_{az}\geq\varepsilon/2,
 \qquad \sigma_{\min}(\bar M_A)\wedge\sigma_{\min}(\bar M_Z)\geq\varepsilon/2,
\]
\[
 \lambda_{\min}(\widehat R^{\mathsf T}\widehat D\widehat R)\geq\varepsilon/2,
 \qquad
 \bar M_{A,jj}-\max_{a\ne j}\bar M_{A,aj}\geq\varepsilon/2
 \quad(j=1,\ldots,K).
\]
Set \(\widehat W=\operatorname{diag}(\widehat w)\), \(\widehat B=\bar M_A\odot\bar M_Z\), \(\widehat d=\widehat B\widehat w\), \(\widehat D=\operatorname{diag}(\widehat d)\), and \(\widehat R=\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B\widehat W\), and then set
\[
 \widehat N=I_{K^2}-\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B
 (\widehat B^{\mathsf T}\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B)^+
 \widehat B^{\mathsf T},
 \qquad \widehat h=\widehat N\widehat c.
\]
Form \(\widehat G\), \(\widehat b_{(\cdot)}\), and \(\widehat b_U\) as implications of this same cleaned product law.  With the known cutoff \(\tau_G=\varepsilon/2\), define
\[
 \widehat Qf_0=\widehat Nf_0-
 \widehat h^{\mathsf T}\widehat G_{\tau_G}^{\dagger}\widehat b_{f_0}.
\]
Neither a true measurement support, the true \(G\), nor \(\operatorname{rank}(G)\) is an input.
